input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows accounting export tool likely outputs CRLF line endings (\r\n), but `parseStatement` splits lines using only `\n`, leaving a trailing carriage return (`\r`) attached to the last field of every row. This causes the column count of the header and rows to mismatch, resulting in the "Malformed row" error on row 1.
